jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Marimekko is a Finnish lifestyle design company renowned for its original prints and colors. The company’s product portfolio includes high-quality clothing, bags and accessories as well as home décor items ranging from textiles to tableware. When Marimekko was founded in 1951, its unparalleled printed fabrics gave it a strong and unique identity. In 2025, the company's net sales totaled EUR 190 million and comparable operating profit margin was 17.1 percent. Globally, there are over 170 Marimekko stores, and online store serves customers in 39 countries. The key markets are Northern Europe, the Asia-Pacific region and North America. The Group employs about 490 people. The company’s share is quoted on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. www.marimekko.com

We are looking for a driven and commercially minded

**FULL STACK DEVELOPER**

to join our **Digital Commerce Development and Composable Tech** team within our Technology unit at Marimekko HQ in Helsinki.

As a Full Stack Developer, you'll create scalable solutions that improve customer experience, increase conversion and improve engagement, and continuously evolve our digital commerce platform using modern technologies, AI-powered development practices, and a test-and-learn mindset. Together with cross-functional teams, you'll ensure our customer-facing experiences are scalable and technologically world-class while bringing new ideas from concept to production in a fast-paced agile environment.

This is a full-time permanent position, in which you will report to our Head of Digital Commerce Development.

**What are your key responsibilities in this role?**

* Be able to work on the full end-to-end process of creating great experiences – you can build solutions that truly work for customers, whether in a native app or e-commerce environment, while also developing scalable backend APIs
* Ensure fast, scalable, and responsive commerce applications by decoupling front-end and back-end technologies
* Use API-first principles, integrate performant third-party tools, implement microservices, work with various databases from in-memory to NoSQL to analytical, and employ real-time monitoring and analytics tools
* Automate and maintain CI/CD pipelines
* Conduct unit, security, and integration testing
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and problem solving
* Ensure rapid deployment of new features

**What will help you succeed in this role?**

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* At least 4 years' experience as a Full Stack Developer, preferably within e-commerce, cloud engineering, or backend development
* You have a solid understanding of what good and modern software development looks like and having a hands-on experience of composable commerce is considered an asset.
* You have a diverse and modern skill set across various domains of digital commerce development, including proficiency in front-end (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and back-end (Node.js, Python, C#) programming languages, cloud platforms (Azure), containerization and container platform tools (Docker, Kubernetes), API development, web security practices, DevOps, version control (Git), and testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and practical experience using AI-powered development tools (such as Claude and similar tools) as part of the development lifecycle.
* Customer-focused mindset, dedicated to delivering seamless, intuitive, and scalable digital experiences.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Fluent in English. Fluent Finnish is an advantage.

At Marimekko we encourage people to be themselves and value diversity. We believe in fairness and doing things together, using common sense and finding joy in our work. If you connect with these values and have the right background, we might be able to offer you a unique opportunity to work in an exciting, international environment with one of the most iconic lifestyle brands.

**Could you be the next Marimekko talent to join our team?**

If all this sparks your interest and you feel like you are the one we are looking for, please submit your application, CV and cover letter, including your salary expectations, via our careers site at company.marimekko.com/careers.
  
  
We will begin interviews during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than 18.10.2026. For more information about the role, please contact Annika Mänty, Head of Digital Commerce Development by phone +358 50 369 0866 on 8.10.2026 between 12.00—13.00 EEST or on 15.10.2026 between 9.00—10.00 EEST.

*Marimekko's culture and working environment are founded on equality, inclusion and cherishing diversity. Marimekko welcomes and encourages everyone regardless of their national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, religion or other personal characteristic to apply. Recruitment is always based on business need, and the candidates are evaluated on relevant knowledge, skills and experience as well as motivation.*  
  
*Marimekko is ranked as the 7th Most Attractive Employer in Finland amongst business professionals according to Universum’s ranking. Marimekko is also the 5th most attractive employer in Finland amongst business students.*

jobs.title: Sitecore Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

**Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen**

**Sitecore Developer (.NET)**

Are you an experienced Sitecore developer who enjoys being close to the code and turning business needs into reliable digital solutions? Twoday is looking for a hands-on developer for a business-critical assignment with a large Danish public-sector organisation.

You will be permanently employed by Twoday, with your first assignment carried out full-time on-site at the client’s offices in Copenhagen.

**The role**

You will join a development team responsible for maintaining, improving and further developing the client’s Sitecore-based solutions. Your focus will be practical software delivery: writing code, troubleshooting, implementing integrations and ensuring that solutions perform reliably in production.

You may contribute to technical decisions and solution design, but this is primarily a hands-on development role rather than a pure architecture position.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Developing and maintaining solutions in Sitecore and C#/.NET
* Implementing new functionality and improving existing solutions
* Building and maintaining integrations and APIs
* Troubleshooting defects and resolving technical issues
* Contributing to testing, code quality, documentation and deployment
* Collaborating closely with developers, testers and business stakeholders

**Your background**

We expect you to have:

* Solid professional experience with Sitecore development
* Strong hands-on skills in C# and .NET
* Experience with integrations, APIs and web-based solutions
* The ability to understand and work confidently in an existing solution landscape
* A structured approach to quality, maintainability and documentation
* The confidence to take responsibility for tasks from clarification through to implementation
* An open and pragmatic approach to using AI-assisted development tools where relevant

Experience with Sitecore upgrades, deployment, performance optimisation or complex public-sector solutions would be an advantage.

**Fluency in spoken and written Danish is essential, as daily collaboration and documentation take place in Danish. You must also be able and willing to work full-time on-site in Copenhagen.**

**What we offer**

At Twoday, you will become part of a strong professional environment where knowledge sharing, collaboration and technical quality are central. You will work on meaningful digital solutions while developing your skills alongside experienced colleagues.

The position is a permanent role at Twoday, working full-time onsite with one of our public-sector customers in Copenhagen.

Interested? We look forward to receiving your application.

**About Twoday**

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions.

**Diversity & inclusion**

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities:**  
Administer the log and search platform (currently Splunk Cloud): indexes, data onboarding, roles and access, apps and knowledge objects, retention, and search and dashboard performance. Monitor ingest latency, skipped searches and licence consumption, and tune to keep cost under control.
  
  
Administer the APM, RUM and infrastructure monitoring platform (currently Splunk Observability Cloud): teams, tokens, integrations, detectors, alert routing and dashboards. Manage metric cardinality and usage against entitlement.
  
  
**Roll out telemetry to all IS applications:** OpenTelemetry Collector (currently the Splunk distribution) on AWS EKS and EC2, and APM instrumentation for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python. Keep instrumentation vendor-neutral where possible so the backend can change without re-instrumenting. Maintain onboarding guides and report coverage per application.
  
  
Set up RUM for customer-facing web and mobile frontends and link browser sessions to backend traces, logs and infrastructure metrics, so an incident can be followed from the user to the data store.
  
  
Build and maintain observability as code (Terraform or equivalent) in Git with peer review and CI/CD, so detectors, dashboards and configuration are versioned, repeatable and free of manual drift.
  
  
**Plan and run platform and agent upgrades with vendors:** define the test plan, validate in non-production, sign off before release, and manage support cases and escalations. Run structured evaluations and proofs of concept when StarHub considers a new or replacement tool.
  
  
Design, build and operate AI and agent-assisted observability workflows, such as alert noise reduction, automated triage, root-cause summaries and natural-language querying, with human review and guardrails.
  
  
Apply controls aligned with MAS-TRM and CSA best practices to telemetry: retention, access control, audit logging, and masking of PII and sensitive data before ingest.
  
  
Perform User Access Reviews (UAR) on the observability platforms at least twice a year, covering user accounts, roles and tokens, and follow up on removals and exceptions. Participate in company-wide audits when required, providing evidence and closing findings on time.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum Profile/ Track Record:**  
Desired Background
  
  
Experience in medium-to-large technology, telecommunications or financial services organizations with complex hybrid-cloud environments and many application teams; has owned an enterprise observability platform, not only used one.
  
  
Seniority, Skills, Certifications (must-haves)
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
  
  
5+ years of relevant experience in observability, monitoring, SRE or platform engineering, including hands-on administration, optimization and health monitoring of an enterprise observability or log analytics platform. Splunk (Cloud or Enterprise) is strongly preferred.
  
  
Hands-on experience with an enterprise APM/RUM/infrastructure monitoring platform across RUM, APM, infrastructure and data-storage monitoring. Splunk Observability Cloud is preferred; Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Elastic or similar is acceptable. Clear understanding of distributed tracing from frontend to backend.
  
  
Experience installing and operating OpenTelemetry-based telemetry on AWS (EKS, EC2) for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python applications.
  
  
Experience managing observability configuration as code (Terraform or equivalent, Git, CI/CD).
  
  
Prior AI delivery experience in observability or IT operations: has taken an AI or agent-based capability into production use by operations or engineering teams.
  
  
Familiarity with security and compliance standards (MAS-TRM, CSA), including telemetry data governance.
  
  
**Certifications are a plus:** Splunk Core Certified Admin or Power User, Splunk Observability Cloud certification, or equivalent vendor certifications on another observability platform.
  
  
Ideal track record #1
  
  
Owned an enterprise observability or log analytics platform at scale (Splunk preferred) as administrator and platform owner, improving search performance, stability or ingest cost, and ran vendor-led upgrades with test and validation plans and no unplanned outage.
  
  
Ideal track record #2
  
  
Rolled out APM and infrastructure telemetry (OpenTelemetry) across a large application estate with RUM-to-backend tracing in use during real incidents, measurably reducing time to detect or resolve.
  
  
Ideal track record #3
  
  
Delivered an AI or agent-based capability in production for monitoring, triage or root-cause analysis, with measurable impact such as less alert noise or faster resolution.
